title: 3-minute speaking notes
promptText:
Convert the long report / circular / briefing note below into speaking notes for a 3-minute oral briefing to senior officers.

Audience: administrative leadership (IAS / senior engineers / circle heads).

Produce:
1. Opening line (10 seconds) — why this matters now
2. Three key points (45 seconds each) — each with one supporting fact from the source
3. Risks / open issues (30 seconds)
4. Recommended next action (20 seconds) — one clear ask
5. Optional Q-bank: 3 likely questions with short answer cues

Rules:
- Speakable language; short clauses; no dense paragraphs.
- Do not invent statistics. If a figure is missing, write [VERIFY].
- Highlight anything that looks like an AI guess with [VERIFY].
- Total speaking notes under 350 words.

SOURCE DOCUMENT:
[Paste or summarise the report]
